environment.description: Same Rails application deployed on EKS with a PodSecurityPolicy (migrated to Pod Security Admission in enforce mode at 'restricted' level). Container securityContext drops ALL capabilities and re-adds only CAP_NET_BIND_SERVICE. Additionally, the pod runs with a read-only root filesystem, non-root user (uid 1000), and an OPA Gatekeeper ConstraintTemplate 'K8sRequireOwnershipFilter' that injects a mutating admission webhook adding an Envoy sidecar. The Envoy sidecar applies an ext_authz filter calling a PDP (Policy Decision Point) service that enforces attribute-based access control: every API response is intercepted and the PDP validates that the 'user_id' field in the database record matches the authenticated principal's subject claim from the JWT. Requests where resource.owner_id != principal.sub receive a 403. The PDP policy is defined in Rego and loaded via ConfigMap. Network policy restricts pod egress to only the PDP service and RDS endpoint.

config.network_policy: egress only to pdp-service.authz.svc and rds-endpoint
config.mutating_webhook: injects envoy sidecar with ext_authz to all api-* namespaces
